verdict.rationale: Dover, a recruiting SaaS, documents an official HTTP MCP server. It gives AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows, can be added directly from the terminal, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented auth and per-tool details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Set up the Dover MCP server to give AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows in Dover.
You can add Dover as an HTTP MCP server directly from your terminal.
Ask in plain English, and your AI client picks the right tool.
